verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an edge compute platform, but the pack has no evidence of a custom-hostname or SaaS-domain provisioning capability for tenants' domains. Universal SSL for domains added to Cloudflare, scoped API tokens, and a broad API covering DNS are adjacent building blocks, not the multi-tenant custom-domain capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can programmatically provision and route custom domains for my own multi-tenant SaaS customers
